items.markdown:
Effective tools for managing ADHD include `digital planning apps, physical organizational systems, and sensory focus aids`.

### Digital Apps and Tech

- **Focusmate** : Uses virtual "body doubling" to pair you with someone else while you both work on tasks.[[1]](https://add.org/adhd-tools-for-adults/)
- **Tiimo** : A visual time-management planner built specifically for neurodivergent brains.[[1]](https://add.org/adhd-tools-for-adults/)
- **Goblin Tools** : Features a "Magic ToDo" function that breaks large or overwhelming chores into small steps.[[1]](https://add.org/adhd-tools-for-adults/)
- **Voice assistants** : Tools like Siri, Alexa, or Google Assistant help set quick alarms and running grocery lists.[[1]](https://www.embracethemuchness.com/blog/my-top-10-tech-tools-to-support-adhd-and-executive-functioning)

### Physical and Analog Tools

- **Bullet Journal (BuJo)** : A customizable, paper-based system that uses simple symbols to get tasks out of your head.[[1]](https://www.adhdadvisor.org/learn/adhd-organization-tools)
- **Visual Timers** : Physical countdown clocks give your brain a clear, visible cue of passing time.[[1]](https://www.adhdspace.ca/blog/managing-adult-adhd-tools-and-strategies-that-actually-work)
- **Landing Stations** : A designated physical spot near your door for essential items like keys, wallets, and phones.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R5nCjKtTTHs)

### Fidget and Sensory Tools

- **Fidget Spinners & Cubes** : Small, tactile items (like the [Klicks Fidget Spinner Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:5319418674349070889,headlineOfferDocid:17888541175322994339,productDocid:17888541175322994339&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiH8bTRgYqXAxU2CTQIHZ-mFGsQxa4PegYIAggeEBo) or an [Antsy Labs Fidget Cube Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462654455515284,imageDocid:7746792035183715091,gpcid:6775971744104812869,headlineOfferDocid:18072397181429244745,catalogid:2208978806830357483,productDocid:15003367392629623907,rds:PC_6775971744104812869%7CPROD_PC_6775971744104812869&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiH8bTRgYqXAxU2CTQIHZ-mFGsQxa4PegYIAggeEBw) ) provide non-distracting sensory feedback to help maintain focus during boring tasks.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17888541175322994339&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:3370288030787734178,catalogid:17630116438775192851,gpcid:10082067386377508681,mid:576462880775317408&ibp=oshop)
- **Chewelry / Discreet Jewelry** : Necklaces or rings with moving parts offer quiet self-regulation on the go.[[1]](https://add.org/adhd-tools-for-adults/)

- What specific executive function area do you want to support (like **time management** or **task initiation**)?
